name: Non-linear Arithmetic Obfuscation
description: Replaced the modular polynomial divisibility test with a mathematically equivalent non-linear arithmetic inequality ($x + y > 2 \min(x, y)$). This prevents the LLM from using standard algebraic simplification to recognize the $x \neq y$ condition (which it used to trigger 3-coloring heuristics), causing it to implement a generic backtracking solver that will Time Limit Exceed on the $n=40$ bounds.
